_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players} a managay diad Surround ed {width}x{height} a grid.
Sika so managay a {player_id}. Saray maong ya kimey: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' o w/s/a/d.
Antabay: aboten mo iray arum a managay. Say dalan so nakamatay; say pakan so nakamatay; say nagpangabong so nakamatay iray duaran.

game_action.invalid_death: Inatey so manlalaban {player_id} lapud ag-agawaen a galaw.

outcome.survived_win: Nakasurvive si Player {player_id}; dinmakel din ang iba.
outcome.all_crashed: Amin ya agagin manpapaliis et nampadparaan.
outcome.outlived: Say player so nabibilay ed arum amin.
outcome.all_dead: Amin ya manlalaro et inatey la.
outcome.turn_limit: No asabi so limitasyon na pagmaliw - say akaligtas ed sankatageyan a panaon et manalo.
